text: Owner clarification: preserve sound existing work as the UI evolves. Design sections 2.1 and 11.6 now require an evidence-based reuse assessment for each affected slice, review of existing/pending implementation before duplication, a smallest-change rationale, preservation comparisons and explicit replacement/retirement evidence. Unverified code is not presumed missing. Baseline bd-01M35A79XQJRP3JTHJYVQ741YZ and M1/four-screen acceptance bodies have been amended; their statuses, dependencies and scope boundaries remain unchanged. Existing supported routes remain available for capabilities whose integrated UI comes later. No new roadmap, runtime rewrite or implementation qualification is created by this clarification.
